continuation_retest.reasoning: RTVP p.6 prefers continuation (break, held retest, continue) and rarely trades reversals. No per-session count is printed. Bound by qualifying HTF-edge true breaks with a held retest, not every close beyond the box.

trapped_buyers_retest.reasoning: TRAP is one worked Asia short with two prior NY failures and a single retest. Dossier S5 says those two sessions are this example, not a universal count. Bound by qualifying trap reads, not every fast arrival.

failed_auction_return.reasoning: AMTL p.8 is a drive into a previous area of fair value, rejection, return into the original range. Frequency unstated. Prior VA must be distinct from the current balance so overlap cannot pass every session.

poc_traversal.source_claim: 80 percent that price runs all the way to the far extreme, 20 percent that it simply ranges inside instead
poc_traversal.reasoning: AMTL p.9 odds are conditional on already being back inside the range after a failed auction, then reading POC behavior (aggressive push with a held retest vs repeated failure to hold). The 80% figure is that conditional traverse rate, not a session pass rate and not a target to hit.
